87760.name: Holy Diver
87760.objective_text: Holy Diver Find a Stormscale Beastmistress, slay her, and bring back her Rod of Deep Dominion. Requirements: - Rod of Deep Dominion

91736.name: Applejack Still
91736.objective_text: Applejack Still A strong scent of apples burns your nose as you inspect the device. Requirements: - Shiny Red Apple x 4

95647.name: Lost in the Thicket Things
95647.objective_text: Lost in the Thicket Things Level 31 Find Ardin Grassman in the Excavation Sites. Requirements: - Learn what happened to Ardin Grassman

95737.name: Seeking Caitlin
95737.objective_text: Seeking Caitlin Level 31 Speak with Caitlin Grassman in Menethil Harbor.

97277.name: Grund and Gozwin
97277.objective_text: Grund and Gozwin Find Grund and Gozwin's camp in the hills to the northwest. Recover Gozwin's Mechanic's Log and kill the Snow Leopard Prowler. Requirements: - Gozwin's Mechanic's Log - Snow Leopard Prowler

97894.name: Business in Auberdine
97894.objective_text: Business in Auberdine Check on Gorbold Steelhand in Auberdine in Darkshore. Borgus mentioned a boat on the southern-most dock in Stormwind Harbor that can take you there. Requirements: - Take the boat to Auberdine and find Gorbold Steelhand.

98071.name: Brewer's Trade
98071.objective_text: Brewer's Trade Deliver the bottles of Fallrook Varietal to Dun Garok in southeast Hillsbrad Foothills, and bring back a sack of their Homebrew Hops. Requirements: - Fallrook Varietal delivered to Dun Garok - Sack of Homebrew Hops

98190.name: A Friend of the Family
98190.objective_text: A Friend of the Family Bring the Menethil Statuette to Highlord Bolvar Fordragon in Stormwind Keep.

98221.name: From the Ashes
98221.objective_text: From the Ashes Captain Stoutfist in Menethil Keep wants you to destroy the 4 sets of Attack Plans in the Angerfang Encampment. Requirements: - Attack Plan: Menethil Harbor destroyed - Attack Plan: Thelsamar destroyed - Attack Plan: Southshore destroyed - Attack Plan: Ironforge destroyed

98463.name: Talk of the Town
98463.objective_text: Talk of the Town Visit Nixxrax Fillamug in the Salty Sailor Tavern in Booty Bay in Stranglethorn.
